tables.name: instances
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE instances (
	id TEXT NOT NULL,
	path TEXT NOT NULL,
	applied_content_set_id TEXT NULL,

	install_stage TEXT NOT NULL,
	launcher_feature_version TEXT NOT NULL,
	update_channel TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'release',

	name TEXT NOT NULL,
	icon_path TEXT NULL,

	created INTEGER NOT NULL,
	modified INTEGER NOT NULL,
	last_played INTEGER NULL,

	submitted_time_played INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
	recent_time_played INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, symlink_target TEXT, pinned_at INTEGER NULL, game_dir_override TEXT, linked_launcher TEXT NULL, linked_launcher_root TEXT NULL, linked_dot_minecraft TEXT NULL, linked_version_id TEXT NULL, linked_version_json_path TEXT NULL, linked_game_dir_mode TEXT NULL,

	PRIMARY KEY (id),
	UNIQUE (path)
)

	content_project_id TEXT NULL,
	content_version_id TEXT NULL,

	hosting_server_id TEXT NULL,
	hosting_instance_ids JSONB NULL,
	hosting_active_instance_id TEXT NULL,

	shared_instance_id TEXT NULL, imported_name TEXT NULL, imported_version_number TEXT NULL, imported_filename TEXT NULL, curseforge_project_id INTEGER NULL, curseforge_file_id INTEGER NULL,

	PRIMARY KEY (instance_id),
	FOREIGN KEY (instance_id) REFERENCES instances(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

tables.name: instance_content_entries

CREATE TABLE instance_content_entries (
	id TEXT NOT NULL,
	instance_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	content_set_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	file_id TEXT NULL,

	project_type TEXT NOT NULL,
	source_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
	server_requirement TEXT NOT NULL,
	client_requirement TEXT NOT NULL,
	enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

	added_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
	modified_at INTEGER NOT NULL, ownership_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user_added'

)

tables.name: instance_pack_members
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE instance_pack_members (
	id TEXT NOT NULL,
	content_set_id TEXT NOT NULL,
	content_entry_id TEXT NULL,
	member_key TEXT NOT NULL,
	project_type TEXT NOT NULL,
	expected_relative_path TEXT NOT NULL,
	provider TEXT NULL,
	provider_project_id TEXT NULL,
	provider_release_id TEXT NULL,
	required INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
	expected_sha1 TEXT NULL,
	expected_size INTEGER NULL,
	expected_fingerprint INTEGER NULL,
	materialization_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'present',
	override_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none',

	CHECK (reconciled IN (0, 1))

CREATE VIEW resource_instance_pack_projects AS

objects.name: resource_instance_content_provider_refs_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER resource_instance_content_provider_refs_insert
AFTER INSERT ON instance_content_provider_refs
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO resource_source_projects(source, project_id)
    SELECT DISTINCT legacy.source, legacy.project_id FROM resource_legacy_projects legacy
    WHERE legacy.source = NEW.provider AND legacy.project_id = NEW.provider_project_id
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM resource_source_projects known
            WHERE known.source = legacy.source AND known.project_id = legacy.project_id);
    INSERT INTO resources(id)
    SELECT project.resource_id FROM resource_source_projects project
    WHERE project.source = NEW.provider AND project.project_id = NEW.provider_project_id
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM resources known WHERE known.id = project.resource_id);
    INSERT INTO resource_source_types(source, project_id, content_type)
    SELECT legacy.source, legacy.project_id, legacy.content_type FROM resource_legacy_projects legacy
    WHERE legacy.source = NEW.provider AND legacy.project_id = NEW.provider_project_id
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM resource_source_types known
            WHERE known.source = legacy.source AND known.project_id = legacy.project_id AND known.content_type = legacy.content_type);
END

objects.name: resource_legacy_projects
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW resource_legacy_projects AS
SELECT DISTINCT source, project_id, content_type FROM (
    SELECT ref.provider AS source, ref.provider_project_id AS project_id, entry.project_type AS content_type
    FROM instance_content_provider_refs ref
    JOIN instance_content_entries entry ON entry.id = ref.content_entry_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT provider, provider_project_id, project_type FROM instance_pack_members
    UNION ALL
    SELECT provider, provider_project_id, project_type FROM instance_pending_manual_downloads
    UNION ALL
    SELECT source, project_id, 'modpack' FROM resource_instance_pack_projects
)
WHERE
    (source = 'modrinth' AND length(project_id) = 8 AND project_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z0-9]*')
    OR (source = 'curseforge' AND project_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
        AND CAST(project_id AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 4294967295
        AND CAST(CAST(project_id AS INTEGER) AS TEXT) = project_id)
    OR (source = 'mcarchive' AND length(project_id) = 36
        AND substr(project_id, 9, 1) = '-' AND substr(project_id, 14, 1) = '-'
        AND substr(project_id, 19, 1) = '-' AND substr(project_id, 24, 1) = '-'
        AND length(replace(project_id, '-', '')) = 32
        AND replace(project_id, '-', '') NOT GLOB '*[^a-fA-F0-9]*')
